shear_stiffness_evidence.formula_scope: Preserved isotropic diagonal section only: S11=E11*TS11, S22=E22*TS22, S12=0; native E12 and TS12 checked zero
shear_stiffness_evidence.native_GET_limitation: GET preprocessing section quantities may not reflect calculated section data; zero/non-SPD E is not treated as actual stiffness
shear_stiffness_evidence.centroid_identity_limitation: Independently exported SHELL181 assumed-strain/incompatible-mode centroid Q and gamma need not reproduce the section constitutive identity; their geometry-dependent ratios are diagnostic, not section stiffness

centroid_constitutive_identification.reason: A constant centroid fit can pass on one uniform geometry and fail after geometry changes; it does not establish the native section stiffness
